title: Battle of Drăgășani
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Drăgășani", at revision 1370439397, opens: "The Battle of Drăgășani was fought on 19 June 1821 in Drăgășani, Wallachia, between the Ottoman forces of Sultan Mahmud II and the Greek Filiki Etaireia insurgents as a part of the Greek War of Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888462, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 Greek battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
